in_hebrew.name: זורינה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew root 'zor' (זור) meaning 'to hide' and 'rina' (רינה) meaning 'star'. It can be interpreted as 'hidden star' or 'star of the night'.

in_greek.name: Ζωρίνη
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek 'zoros' (ζωρός) meaning 'dawn, morning' and 'rhēnē' (ῥένη) meaning 'flowing, flowing river'. It can be interpreted as 'dawn star' or 'flowing star'.

in_latin.name: Zorina
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin 'zor' (zor) meaning 'dawn, morning' and 'ina' (ina) meaning 'woman'. It can be interpreted as 'dawn woman' or 'woman of the morning'.
